svg.text: Digital twin: Asset Administration Shell 3.2 and AutomationML 2.1 ontology

18 nodes · 13 relationships · 1 implied labels, generated from crosswalk.json, from the model.json of Asset Administration Shell 3.2, AutomationML Edition 2.1 (CAEX 3.0). The main arrows are named by their relationship type; hover any arrow for its name and description, and cards link to the term in its standard.
subtype: also carries the supertype's label

path.title: SAME_AS: aas:AssetAdministrationShell skos:closeMatch aml:InternalElement. An AAS is serialised as an internal element with the role class AssetAdministrationShellRoleClassLib/AssetAdministrationShell, named by its idShort (AR 004E rules 2, 14 and 16). Its id becomes the value of an AutomationML attribute, not the internal element's ID, which stays a UUID. Linked nodes share idShort and name.

SAME_AS: aas:AssetInformation skos:closeMatch aml:InternalElement. The asset an AAS describes is an internal element with the role class AssetAdministrationShellRoleClassLib/Asset (AR 004E 5.1.2). The recommendation was written for AAS metamodel 2.0, where the asset was an identifiable of its own; in 3.x it is the shell's asset information, with no idShort to name the element by.

SAME_AS: aas:Submodel skos:closeMatch aml:InternalElement. A submodel of kind Instance is an internal element with the role class AssetAdministrationShellRoleClassLib/Submodel, named by its idShort, inside the shell's internal element (AR 004E rules 2, 16 and 5.1.3). Linked nodes share idShort and name.

RELATED_TO: aas:Submodel skos:relatedMatch aml:SystemUnitClass. A submodel of kind Template, and the shell holding it, become system unit classes in a system unit class library, e.g. AssetAdministrationShellSystemUnitClasses, carrying the same roles as their instances (AR 004E rules 24 to 26).

SAME_AS: aas:SubmodelElement skos:closeMatch aml:InternalElement. Every submodel element is an internal element whose role class is its subtype, e.g. AssetAdministrationShellRoleClassLib/Property, named by its idShort; a collection's elements are internal elements inside it (AR 004E rules 9 and 13). Linked nodes share idShort and name.

RELATED_TO: aas:File skos:relatedMatch aml:ExternalDataReference. A File element's internal element references its file through a FileDataReference interface, derived from ExternalDataReference, whose refURI and MIMEType attributes carry the file's path and content type (AR 004E rule 10 and 4.7).

RELATED_TO: aas:ReferenceElement skos:relatedMatch aml:InternalLink. A reference element pointing inside the AAS has a ReferableReference interface, joined by an internal link to the element it refers to; an external reference is a serialised string instead (AR 004E rule 11).

RELATED_TO: aas:RelationshipElement skos:relatedMatch aml:InternalLink. A relationship element's first and second elements are ReferableReference interfaces, each joined by an internal link to the element it refers to when that is inside the AAS (AR 004E rule 11).

SAME_AS: aas:ConceptDescription skos:closeMatch aml:InternalElement. A concept description is an internal element with the role class AssetAdministrationShellRoleClassLib/ConceptDescription, in an instance hierarchy such as AssetAdministrationShellConceptDescriptions. Its name joins its idShort, ID type and ID, so the names don't match (AR 004E rules 15 and 20).
SAME_AS: aas:Qualifier skos:closeMatch aml:Attribute. A qualifier is a complex attribute named Qualifier:<type>=<value>, with the qualifier's own attributes as nested attributes (AR 004E rule 7).

RELATED_TO: aas:Reference skos:relatedMatch aml:Attribute. A reference-valued attribute of an AAS element, e.g. its semanticId, is an attribute whose value is the reference serialised as a string (AR 004E rule 6 and 6.2.6). The attribute's RefSemantic, e.g. AAS:HasSemantics/semanticId, names the metamodel attribute it holds, not the reference's meaning.

SAME_AS: aas:Property skos:closeMatch aml:Attribute. An AAS property can publish an AutomationML attribute of the element that holds the asset's engineering data, named as the attribute and holding its value; the recommendation relates them by a RelationshipElement in the AutomationML submodel, or by a property already in another submodel such as the Digital Nameplate (AR AMLinAAS 3.3). Linked nodes share idShort and name, value.

RELATED_TO: aas:Key skos:relatedMatch aml:RefSemantic. An attribute published as a property shares its meaning: the key of the property's semanticId, e.g. an ECLASS IRDI, is the path the attribute's RefSemantic gives. AR 004E uses RefSemantic differently, for the AAS metamodel attribute an attribute serialises (6.2.5), so this holds for published engineering attributes, not for a serialised AAS. Linked nodes share value and correspondingAttributePath.
Every aas__RelationshipElement is also a aas__SubmodelElement

g.title: aas__AssetAdministrationShell — An asset administration shell. Properties: uid, id, category, idShort
aas__AssetInformation — In 'AssetInformation' identifying meta data of the asset that is represented by an AAS is defined. Properties: uid, assetKind, globalAssetId, assetType
aas__ConceptDescription — The semantics of a property or other elements that may have a semantic description is defined by a concept description. Properties: uid, id, category, idShort
aas__File — A File is a data element that represents an address to a file (a locator). Properties: uid, value, contentType, category, idShort
aas__Key — A key is a reference to an element by its ID. Properties: uid, type, value
aas__Property — A property is a data element that has a single value. Properties: uid, valueType, value, category, idShort
aas__Qualifier — A qualifier is a type-value-pair that makes additional statements w.r.t. the value of the element. Properties: uid, kind, type, valueType, value
aas__Reference — Reference to either a model element of the same or another AAS or to an external entity. Properties: uid, type

aas__ReferenceElement — A reference element is a data element that defines a logical reference to another element within the same or another AAS or a reference to an external object or entity. Properties: uid, category, idShort

aas__RelationshipElement — A relationship element is used to define a relationship between two elements being either referable (model reference) or external (global reference). Properties: uid, category, idShort
aas__Submodel — A submodel defines a specific aspect of the asset represented by the AAS. Properties: uid, id, category, idShort, kind
aas__SubmodelElement — A submodel element is an element suitable for the description and differentiation of assets. Properties: uid, category, idShort

aml__InternalElement — Shall be used in order to define nested objects inside of a SystemUnitClass or another InternalElement. Allows description of the internal structure of a CAEX object. Defines base structures for a hierarchical object instance. The instance maybe part of the InstanceHierarchy or a SystemUnitClass. Properties: id, refBaseSystemUnitPath, name, changeMode, description, version, copyright, additionalInformation

aml__Attribute — Characterizes properties of the SystemUnitClass. Defines base structures for attribute definitions. Properties: id, unit, attributeDataType, refAttributeType, defaultValue, value, name, changeMode, description, version, copyright, additionalInformation

aml__RefSemantic — A reference to a definition of a defined attribute, e. g. to an attribute in a standardized library, this allows the semantic definition of the attribute. Properties: id, correspondingAttributePath, changeMode, description, version, copyright, additionalInformation

aml__InternalLink — Shall be used in order to define the relationships between internal interfaces of InternalElements. Properties: id, refPartnerSideA, refPartnerSideB, name, changeMode, description, version, copyright, additionalInformation

aml__SystemUnitClass — Shall be used for SystemUnitClass definition, provides definition of a class of a SystemUnitClass type. Defines base structures for a hierarchical SystemUnitClass tree. The hierarchical structure of a SystemUnit library has organizational character only. Properties: id, refBaseClassPath, name, changeMode, description, version, copyright, additionalInformation

aml__ExternalDataReference — The AutomationML interface class ExternalDataReference, from the AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib (Standard Automation Markup Language Interface Class Library) 2.10.0, at AutomationMLInterfaceClassLib/AutomationMLBaseInterface/ExternalDataConnector/ExternalDataReference. It is an ExternalDataConnector. Carried by an ExternalInterface whose RefBaseClassPath refers to this interface class, or to one derived from it. The interface class defines the attributes MIMEType. Properties: id, refBaseClassPath, name, changeMode, description, version, copyright, additionalInformation
